project_name: NAMAN UPPER Factory ERP - Print Layout Corrections
scope: Concise layout guidance for vertical (portrait) paper dimensions (A5 portrait), print page rules, typography, and test identifiers for NAMAN UPPER factory print views. No full app redesign.

user_choices.plan_number_formatting: Clear prefix layout like P/01 or P/26/01 displaying year clearly

print_layout_rules.page_setup: @media print { @page { size: A5 portrait; margin: 8mm; } body { background: white; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; } .no-print { display: none !important; } .print-page { margin: 0 auto; padding: 6mm 8mm; width: 100%; max-width: 148mm; box-sizing: border-box; } }
print_layout_rules.screen_preview: .print-page { background: white; max-width: 148mm; min-height: 210mm; margin: 16px auto; padding: 10mm; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; color: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); }
print_layout_rules.table_formatting: Keep table font size compact (10px-11px), padding 3px 5px, avoid overflow, ensure clear high-contrast solid borders (#94a3b8) for reliable thermal/dot-matrix or inkjet printing.
print_layout_rules.totals_and_matrices: Preserve size-composition matrices across all slip views. Maintain backend calculated total bags, total pairs, and total bundles accurately inside vertical A5 print boundaries.

specific_requirements.plan_no_display: Format plan numbers clearly with financial year / year code (e.g. P/26/01 or P/01) in doc-meta header.
specific_requirements.qc_auto_fields: Ensure QC Number and QC Date auto-populate on the QC list and QC print views.
specific_requirements.production_tab_dispatch_date: Display Dispatch Date on Production tab items and detail summaries.
specific_requirements.dispatch_slip_matrix: Keep size-composition matrix and backend total bags calculation perfectly aligned without horizontal overflow.

testing_and_attributes.attribute_rules: All print buttons, slip header sections, document meta values, and print tables MUST include clear kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure existing files under /app/frontend/src/pages/print/ and /app/frontend/src/index.css use A5 vertical portrait styling (@page { size: A5 portrait; margin: 8mm; }). Do not redesign business views or change core backend logic. Preserve existing size-composition matrix and totals.
